summary: Recon Technology, Ltd filed an SEC Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $100 million of its Class A ordinary shares. The filing establishes a Sales Agreement with Pacific Century Securities LLC as sales agent, with a commission rate of up to 3.5%. No specific price, premium, or target is stated; shares are sold at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or similar event. The ATM offering is an ordinary shelf takedown and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
